{{Quote|We've made a few modifications: boosted power to the double laser cannons up top, new ion drives, better flux controllers on the shields, and some extra hull armor.|[[Nazrita Villache]]|<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref>}}
A '''flux controller''' was a component used in [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generators]]. Better flux controllers were added to the generators as part of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] modifications.<ref name="PSG" />
